tickets.open.guard: A ticket for this task is already open.
tickets.open.statement: INSERT INTO tickets (ref, title, opened_at) SELECT ?1, ?2, ?3 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tickets WHERE ref = ?1 AND closed_at IS NULL)

tickets.count.statement: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open FROM tickets WHERE closed_at IS NULL

tickets.board.statement: SELECT ref, title FROM tickets WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 20
